coverage: Read the whole once for layout, half a once and half b once line by line against C and textual H. Covered heading; top framed note; every opening line, overwritten start and interline addition; the complete large cancelled proof, its nested diagonal attempt, border, hatching and long obliques; left oval note; complete live proof and all local cancellations; closing paragraph and its call lines; blank margins and pencil archive 24. Remaining unreadability is explicitly marked; no OCR, external sources, other page or other reader used. No mathematical proof check was performed.

notes.text: The handwritten heading names SGA 4 IX p. 42; the body labels itself (*) (Note pour la page 8.). The top framed note says that the stated equivalent conditions of VI 1.25 will also be proved. No date or total page count is written; pencil 24 is recorded only as the archive sheet number.
notes.basis: Observation of heading, top note, opening label and lower-left corner; resolves earlier C heading note.

notes.text: The live opening asks to identify the constructibility notion of 2.3 for a sheaf of sets with that of VI 1.9.3. It reduces locally to affine X, with the interline words donc “cohérent”, i.e. The classes C and C prime are introduced and the target is C=C prime.
notes.basis: Source exposition in opening paragraph; summary only, not a proof check.

notes.text: An earlier proof from En vertu de VII 5.6 a) through cas particulier de 2.1 is cancelled by large obliques, a stepped border, and a further cross-hatched internal attempt concerning a diagonal. The written forms C prime est formé, puisque un and C subset C prime, Mais are retained. The upper superseded opening reads Je faut, despite its grammar.
notes.basis: Observed cancellation state and literal readings; no mathematical claim has been tested.

notes.text: The replacement proof cites VI 2.9, b), lists finite inductive and projective limits, a generating class and quasi-compact objects, then uses a written epimorphism G to F and the references VII 5.6.1 and VI 1.3. The source ends qfd. The inserted en vertu de sits above the still live de 2.7, so both de tokens are preserved.
notes.basis: Live proof text and crop 15 correction state; no independent re-proof or cited-result verification.

notes.text: The crossed left oval retains an uncertain first word pourquoi/pour and readable lower words par exemple. Its mathematical purpose is not assigned. This preserves the earlier C caution about not attaching a definite objection.
notes.basis: Crop 13; observation separated from any inference about the objection.

notes.text: The closing paragraph says there would have been occasion to refondre les §§ 1,2, notably by relating them to the general finiteness notions of VI, and leaves this rédaction to générations futures. The call inserts notamment before en les rattachant. The cancelled words explicitement and complémentaire remain tentative.
notes.basis: Half b and crops 19–20; confirms earlier C note about deferred rewriting, without supplementing the text.
